description: This file is an example script demonstrating the setup and initialization of the Google OAuth2 provider using the league/oauth2-google PHP library. It configures client credentials, initiates a session, and returns the configured provider object.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: The Google provider class from the League OAuth2 client library used for OAuth2 authentication with Google services.
